findings.plain: bad loans are being reported as good ones

signals.explanation: Loans the tape shows going from 30-59 days late to current were pulled from the servicer system: 12 of 25 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
Servicer-system pull: 2 of 60 sampled 'eligible' loans are actually 60+ days late or no longer active

steps.title: Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
steps.draft:
INTERNAL ACTION MEMO — Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
Case: B0093 · Finding: bad loans are being reported as good ones (high confidence)

  - Loans the tape shows going from 30-59 days late to current were pulled from the servicer system: 12 of 25 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active [ref S2-B0093-TARGETED_SOURCE_MISMATCH-b327067c]

[Credit officer], Wells Fargo
